scheme_name: Haryana Provision of Sports Equipment Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a Municipal Body or Gram Panchayat of Haryana.
A Field of Play (FoP) for the sport must be available in the town/village.
benefits_summary: Provides sport‑specific equipment kits (balls, nets, mats, cricket kits, etc.) to eligible Municipal Bodies and Gram Panchayats.
